functions.notes: Target computes log2 of w and h with an inlined clz (31-clz) instead of the compare chain. No clz intrinsic exists in this compiler (__builtin_clz, __clz, __CLZ, __cntlzw all undefined), and the only route is inline asm (as in func_020b1ec0), which the rules forbid. The shape and registers cannot be reached without it. Source left as the coordinator's version.
